title: DoorMemory
description: Automatically closes wooden doors after you walk away.
body:
DoorMemory is a lightweight client-side QoL mod that remembers wooden doors you open and closes them automatically once you move away.

It keeps your base, villages, and builds from being filled with open doors without changing the vanilla feel of the game. Simple, clean, and made for players who like small quality-of-life improvements that just work in the background.
